jobs.title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead
jobs.description: Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer Background Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love : a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce. We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built. The Role We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar. We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool. Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition. Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's. If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Two designers. 20,000+ doctors. Millions of patients. That's our current ratio of team to impact. If you've worked on teams where your designs disappeared into endless review cycles, this is the opposite. SeriousMD and NowServing are healthcare products that people actually use daily. We need a Senior UI/UX Designer who can own product areas end-to-end, from research to shipped pixels. About Us Leapfroggr builds SeriousMD (the EMR platform Filipino doctors trust) and NowServing (connecting patients to providers nationwide). Our products handle real medical records, real appointments, real patient care. We're a small team by design. No layers, no approvals queue, no "let's circle back." You'll work directly with our Design Lead, engineers, and founders. What you design this week can ship next week. What You'll Actually Do Own UI/UX design for entire product areas across web, iOS, and Android. Take features from user research through wireframes through polished UI through shipped product. Build and extend our design system — we care about consistency at scale. Collaborate daily with engineering to make sure what ships matches what you designed. Run usability tests with real doctors and patients, then iterate based on what you learn. Present your work, defend your decisions, and stay open when you're wrong. What We Offer Remote-friendly (distributed across the Philippines) Health insurance Flexible hours Paid leave (sick, vacation, maternity/paternity, bereavement) Real ownership — your name is on the work, and the work matters How to Apply Send your portfolio showing your process, not just final screens. Tell us which of our products (SeriousMD or NowServing) you'd want to work on first, and why.
